novelty_flags.label: Lemma profiled-score-equivalence; Open-ended Question 2; DGSCondition
novelty_flags.one_line: The core calls (A-e)(barτw-τ) the Dhawan--Guo--Shah population score and applies Corollary 2 to directions on (A,X), but the cited paper defines sP as a projection onto its declared function class and Corollary 2 uses Corr(sP(X),ξP(X)); the specialization and its effect size must be derived from that definition.

soundness_flags.label: def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated set is a class of observed-data laws P but its membership conditions quantify unrepresented potential outcomes and their independence from A; define a full-data class plus its observed image, or state the equivalent observed-law restrictions.

soundness_flags.label: rhoStarKnown and Theorem 1
soundness_flags.one_line: The known-propensity radius is only described in prose: the test domain and information structure when e is supplied are not specified, so it is not yet a defined minimax functional.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.2, equations (16)--(17) and Corollary 2; Section 4.2 definition immediately preceding Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines sP as the L2 projection of the score residual onto GP, defines ξP from the hunted/debiased function of its X, and states Corollary 2 using CorrP(sP(X),ξP(X)|ĥ) with nρn²εn→∞.

Assumption 4 requires L2 oP(n^-1/4) errors for propensity, outcome regression, and CATE learners, plus OP(n^-1/2) ATE error; Theorem 1 gives asymptotic validity of the intra-fold split CATE-variance test.
The paper gives lower and upper results for random-uniform-design Gaussian regression using quadratic U-statistics, with a separation-rate corollary under its ellipsoid conditions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 295--321, abstract and main theorem discussion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies nonparametric heteroskedasticity testing with Hölder mean and variance functions, establishes a sharp rate, and uses a first-order squared-difference proxy statistic; it is not a CATE-homogeneity theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Re-derive the Dhawan--Guo--Shah specialization from its risk class with X=(A,Z), explicitly identify its projected score, direction space, effect-size energy, and only then compare its Corollary 2 condition with V(P).
Split the experiment into a full-data causal class and an observed-law image, then redefine rhoStarKnown as an infimum over measurable tests taking (O^n,e) as input.

After repairing the comparator translation, add a phase-specific theorem comparing the corrected-energy test with both Yu's IF-SS test and DGS under their actual stated conditions, including legal strict-inclusion witnesses.

recommended_next_step: Revise the observed/full-law and oracle-experiment definitions and repair the DGS specialization before advancing this otherwise strong sharp-frontier kernel.
